source.author: verg
source.text: sic oculos, sic ille manus, sic ora ferebat; et nunc aequali tecum pubesceret aevo.
source.text_original: sic oculos, sic ille manus, sic ora ferebat; / et nunc aequali tecum pubesceret aevo.'
source.text_english: So he had such eyes, such hands, such a face; and now he would be growing up with you at the same age.

reuse.author: hier
reuse.text: tenemus pro illo dulcissimos liberos; uxor heres pudicitiae pretium est; Nebridius pusio patrem quaerentibus exhibet: sic oculos, sic ille manus, sic ora ferebat.
reuse.text_original: tenemus pro illo dulcissimos liberos; uxor heres pudicitiae pretium est; Nebridius pusio patrem quaerentibus exhibet: sic oculos, sic ille manus, sic ora ferebat.
reuse.text_english: We have in his place his most dear children; his wife is the heir and the price of his chastity; little Nebridius is his father’s image to those who look for him: thus he had his eyes, thus his hands, thus his face.
